summary: Cross Country Healthcare Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing entry into a definitive merger agreement to be acquired by KL Criss Cross Intermediate, LLC (parent) via merger for $13.25 per share in cash. The consideration represents a premium to the recent trading price; the filing does not explicitly state the premium percentage. The board recommended the transaction; no financial advisor is named in the excerpt. The merger will result in the company surviving as a wholly owned subsidiary of parent. Shareholders (excluding treasury, parent-owned, and dissenting shares) receive cash. Restricted stock and performance awards are cashed out. Regulatory approvals and stockholder vote are customary conditions. Watch for shareholder litigation or a competing bid that could alter deal terms or timing.
